# Recon 6

> Recon 6 (r6coaching.com) is a Rainbow Six Siege coaching tool: attack and defense plans for 25 maps with five operator jobs per round, match prep, screenshot-based AI VOD review, and a Windows desktop coach. It is built by Aaron Henry in Texas, USA, and is fan-made, not affiliated with Ubisoft.

## Plans
- Basic: free. Bank and Coastline sample strats, operator lineups, and the map and callout reference.
- Pro: $12/month. Advanced strategies, 20 AI VOD reviews a month (5 screenshots each), and the Recon 6 Command desktop coach for Windows.
- Elite: $39/month. Everything in Pro, 60 AI VOD reviews a month (up to 10 screenshots each), premium tactics, and recurring-mistake reports.
- Champion: $70/month. Everything in Elite, 75 AI VOD reviews a month, and 2 live 1:1 coaching sessions with Aaron each month.
- 1-on-1 coaching without a plan: $40 a session; a player's first session is $20.
- Paid plans bill at checkout; there is no free trial. The first charge has a 7-day money-back window, and members cancel from the Stripe customer portal on their Account page.

## Facts
- Recon 6 is not a boosting service: nobody logs into a player's game account.
- The website does not inject into or modify Rainbow Six Siege. The desktop coach reads the player's own capture feed and never touches the game process.
- AI usage on the website is capped per plan; extra usage is prepaid, with no automatic overage.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://r6coaching.com/): what Recon 6 does, with a free strat preview
- [Plans and pricing](https://r6coaching.com/pricing): every plan side by side
- [Map strats](https://r6coaching.com/strats): attack and defense plans by map and site
- [Free Bank defense plan](https://r6coaching.com/strats/bank/ceo/defense): a full round plan with no account
- [1-on-1 coaching](https://r6coaching.com/coaching/): live sessions with Aaron
- [About and contact](https://r6coaching.com/about): who builds Recon 6 and how to reach him
- [Press kit](https://r6coaching.com/press): logos, screenshots and product copy
- [Refund policy](https://r6coaching.com/refund), [Privacy policy](https://r6coaching.com/privacy), [Terms](https://r6coaching.com/terms)
